main_body: two-story half-timbered tavern building with tiled roof
top_band: orange-brown tiled roof slope across rows 0-43, plus wooden porch roof rows 61-65
evidence: Rows 0-43 show the full foreshortened roof slope with individual tile rows and chimney top opening (rows 8-10). Row 44 is the dark roof edge, followed by a 2px eave shadow on the plaster wall at rows 45-46. The vertical front facade spans rows 45-95 with recessed door (rows 69-92), windows with sills, and an overhanging porch lintel (rows 61-66).

style.evidence: The roof tiles use a 6-step warm brown/orange ramp with individual tile highlights and deep crevices matching the reference. The plaster walls have rich multi-tone speckle texture and eave shadows, timber beams and door planks are shaded with dark brown material outlines, and the stone base and windows add high per-tile detail.
